p: Evidence found in passenger Lin's room: SMS records on passenger Lin's phone show that wealthy businessman Zhen will take a batch of stolen diamonds on the 666 train on January 19th to Moscow.
The evidence found in passenger Lin's room is a letter that seems to be trying to kill someone.
The evidence file bag found in Lin's passenger's room contains photos of some containers and a small Russian mafia logo on the cargo number document.
The evidence ledger found in Lin's passenger's room recorded some information about cooperative clients, including wealthy businessman Zhen.

Evidence found in the deceased's room - Text message on the phone - Zhen: Respected Mafia boss, what do you think of the gun I gave you this time? Is it better than Uncle Li's? Mafia boss: Not bad, it seems that you are also a good choice for cooperation!
The evidence found in passenger Lin's room showed dried bloodstains on the cuffs.

The evidence found in passenger Lin's room was Dong's phone, which contained a video of the door number of wealthy businessman Zhen. The conversation between Li Shu and wealthy businessman Zhen inside the concealed door clearly indicated that Li Shu was a girl.

Mr. Li, where did you hear the rumors? I am your most reliable partner Uncle Li: Don't play Tai Chi with me anymore. We all know who you are and I won't beat around the bush. Uncle Li has been on this road for so many years, and your territory can't be taken away just by giving some benefits. Since you won't listen to my advice, you can be careful when walking on the night road
The autopsy report shows six knife wounds on the deceased's body, with varying widths. The fatal injury was a knife wound about 4cm wide on the chest and heart.
The autopsy report shows that the deceased died around 23:45
The deceased lived in the 7th carriage
It takes at least 3 minutes to walk from one carriage to another.
2-step: Lin, the passenger, should be Uncle Li
The wealthy businessman Zhen wants to replace Uncle Li's position in the mafia, but Uncle Li, also known as Lin Passenger, is very dissatisfied
The deceased may have been killed by many people with knives, but only at 23:45 was the person who gave fatal injuries and directly caused death.
Lin, the passenger, must have been to the victim's room and gave the victim a knife, but it is unclear whether it was a fatal knife.
The passenger was still in the ninth carriage at 23:40
The white passenger was still in the ninth carriage at 23:40
3-step: Lin, the passenger, wanted to kill the wealthy businessman Zhen to vent his anger because he was dissatisfied with his desire to replace his position.
Dong passenger cannot commit murder at 23:45 due to drug effects
White passengers cannot commit murder at 23:45
白乘客: At 23:30, the white passenger stole the seat chart of the seagull attendant in the 9th carriage and saw the seagull attendant enter the lounge. At 23:40, Bai passenger saw Sa passenger walking towards the 8th carriage. He didn't want to ask him to secretly return to his carriage, but was caught and decided to go to the 7th carriage later
鸥乘务: At 23:55, the Ou attendant pushed a cart from the lounge towards the direction of the Zhen wealthy merchant's carriage. Due to nervousness, the Ou attendant walked quickly. When they reached carriage 7, the Ou attendant met passengers Lin and Dong in the corridor. Lin returned to his private room, while Dong walked towards the direction of carriage nine.
At 22:40, passenger Dong took the ham sausage that passenger Ou had put in laxatives and ate it. The laxatives started to take effect for an hour and were estimated to last for 10 minutes.
撒乘客: At 23:40, the Sa passenger was about to go to the 7th carriage to kill someone, but he was a bit conflicted about the time. When he arrived in the 9th carriage, he turned around and saw Sa passenger who had also arrived in the 9th carriage. With a conflicted heart, he decided to kill someone a little later.
